title: Ziyarat of Imam Husayn
intro: The individual salutation to Imam Husayn in the source collection, kept separate from Ashura, Waritha and occasion-specific forms.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Husayn with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

Ziarat Ashura

Ziarat Taziyat on Ashura at Asr

Ziarats at shrine

blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
Your two servants and friends,
the two sons of Your Messengers, the two grandsons of Mercy,
and the two chiefs of the youth of Paradise,

blocks.arabic: أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَوْلاَدِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ وَٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
blocks.transliteration: afdala ma sallayta `ala ahadin min awladi alnnabiyyina walmursalina
blocks.english: with the most excellent blessings that You have ever sent upon any of the sons of the Prophets and the Messengers.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَسَنِ ٱبْنِ سَيِّدِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala alhasani ibni sayyidi alnnabiyyina
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Hasan the son of the chief of the Prophets
and the successor of the Commander of the Faithful.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah's Messenger.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the Prophets’ successors.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.english: I bear witness that you are verily the son of the Commander of the Faithful,
the trustee of Allah, and the son of His trustee.
You lived upright and persecuted
and passed away as martyr.
And I bear witness that you are verily the pure,
guiding, and well-guided leader.
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon him
and convey to his soul and body

blocks.arabic: فِي هٰذِهِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَفْضَلَ ٱلتَّحِيَّةِ وَٱلسَّلاَمِ
blocks.transliteration: fi hadhihi alssa`ati afdala alttahiyyati walssalami
blocks.english: at this hour the best greeting and salutation from me.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Husayn the son of `Ali,
the oppressed, the martyr,
the slain by the unbelievers, and the thrown down by the sinful people.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah's Messenger.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ مُوقِناً أَنَّكَ أَمِينُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنُ أَمِينِهِ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu muqinan annaka aminu allahi wabnu aminihi
blocks.english: I bear witness with full conviction that you are verily the trustee of Allah and the son of His trustee.
You were killed wrongly and you passed away as martyr.

blocks.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَعَالَىٰ ٱلطَّالِبُ بِثَأْرِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna allaha ta`ala alttalibu bitha'rika
blocks.english: I also bear witness that Allah the All-exalted is the One Who shall avenge You

blocks.arabic: وَمُنْجِزٌ مَا وَعَدَكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّصْرِ وَٱلتَّأْيِيدِ
blocks.transliteration: wa munjizun ma wa`adaka min alnnasri waltta'yidi
blocks.english: and shall fulfill His promise to You of support and victory
through exterminating your enemies and demonstrating your call (to the true guidance).

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka wafayta bi`ahdi allahi
blocks.english: I also bear witness that you fulfilled your covenant with Allah,
strove hard for His sake,

blocks.arabic: وَعَبَدْتَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصاً حَتَّىٰ أَتَاكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
blocks.transliteration: wa `abadta allaha mukhlisan hatta ataka alyaqinu
blocks.english: and served Allah sincerely until death came upon you.
May Allah curse the people who killed you.
May Allah curse the people who disappointed you.
May Allah curse the people who incited people against you.

blocks.arabic: وَأَبْرَأُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ مَمَّنْ كَذَّبَكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa abra'u ila allahi ta`ala mamman kadhdhabaka
blocks.english: I release myself before Allah the All-exalted from those who belied you,

blocks.transliteration: wa istakhaffa bihaqqika wa istahalla damaka
blocks.english: belittled your right, and allowed themselves to shed your blood.

blocks.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya aba `abdi allahi
blocks.english: May my father and mother be ransoms for you.
Allah's curse be on those who killed you.
Allah's curse be on those who let you down.

blocks.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ سَمِعَ وَاعِيَتَكَ فَلَمْ يُجِبْكَ وَلَمْ يَنْصُرْكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man sami`a wa`iyataka falam yujibka wa lam yansurka
blocks.english: Allah's curse be on those who heard your call (for help), but they refrained from responding to you or supporting you.

blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man saba nisa'aka
blocks.english: Allah's curse be on those who captured your women.

blocks.arabic: أَنَا إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ بَرِيءٌ وَمِمَّنْ وَالاَهُمْ
blocks.transliteration: ana ila allahi minhum bari'un wa mimman walahum
blocks.english: I disavow them all before Allah and disavow those who adhered to them,
those who kept up with them, and those who helped them against you.

blocks.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ وَٱلأَئِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِكَ كَلِمَةُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka wal-a'immata min wuldika kalimatu alttaqwai
blocks.english: I also bear witness that you and the Imams from your descendants are the word of piety,
the door to true guidance, the firmest handle,
and the argument against the inhabitants of this world.
I also bear witness that I have full faith in you,
I have conviction in your standing,
and I always follow you in myself,
in the laws of my religion, in my sealing deeds,

blocks.transliteration: wa munqalabi wa mathwaya fi dunyaya wa akhirati
blocks.english: in my tour, and in my settlement in this worldly life and the Hereafter.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام حسین علیہ السلام کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
